newsitem.title: USA: Bomb hoax diverts USAir flight to Dayton.
newsitem.headline: Bomb hoax diverts USAir flight to Dayton.

text.p: One passenger was arrested on Sunday after a bomb hoax forced a USAir airliner to make an emergency landing at Dayton, Ohio, a spokeswoman for the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) said.
The Boeing 757 landed safely and a search of the plane found no bomb, she said.

The flight was en route from Philadelphia to Los Angeles when it was diverted to the southwest Ohio city, where it landed at 10:20 a.m. EDT (1420 GMT). Eight people were injured during the evacuation.
The Federal Bureau of Investigation said Richard Allan Josephson, 37, of Wilmington, Del., was arrested and was to appear before a U.S. magistrate Sunday.
